# Design

How this app is built: its stack, layout and conventions.
Read it with `AGENTS.md`, which has the working rules and how the app is tested.

*TanStack's own documentation is vendored in this repo under `docs/tanstack/`: the official
`llms.txt` index for TanStack Router (`router.llms.txt`) and TanStack Query (`query.llms.txt`).
Consult it when working with TanStack Router or Query.*

---

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints — routes MUST live under `rest/api/`

Put every domain REST route under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/` so its path starts
with `/api/`: `SpaConfig` only lets `/api/*` reach the backend, and a non-`/api/` route is swallowed
by the SPA deep-link fallback (it returns `index.html`, not your endpoint). The reference below uses
non-`/api/` example paths for brevity — in this app the `/api/` prefix is required. See
`src/main/resources/officefloor/README.md`.

---

*The following is OfficeFloor's own agent guidance for this stack, included verbatim
from <https://officefloor.net/AGENTS.md>. It is part of the OfficeFloor architecture.*

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints

Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.

- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.
- Transactions: `govern: [ transaction ]` on steps, not `@Transactional`.
- Errors: a handler YAML in `officefloor/escalation/`, not `@ControllerAdvice`.

### Worked example — `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`

The whole shape of an endpoint. The sections after this one are the reference.

`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`

```yaml
# First step runs first. Validate before Load so an invalid body is a 400,
# not masked by a 404 for a missing owner.
validate:
  class: com.example.owner.ValidateOwner
  next: load
load:
  class: com.example.owner.LoadOwner
  next: apply
apply:
  class: com.example.owner.ApplyOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save
save:
  class: com.example.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond
respond:
  class: com.example.owner.RespondWithOwner
```

```java
// One public method each. State moves by Out<T> (set) → @Val (read), matched by type.
public class ValidateOwner {
  public void validate(@RequestBody @Valid OwnerRequest request, Out<OwnerRequest> body) {
    body.set(request); // body read once here; republished for later steps
  }
}
public class LoadOwner {
  public void load(@PathVariable("ownerId") int ownerId, OwnerRepository repository,
      Out<Owner> ownerOut) throws OwnerNotFoundException {
    Owner owner = repository.findById(ownerId);
    if (owner == null) throw new OwnerNotFoundException(ownerId); // handled below
    ownerOut.set(owner);
  }
}
public class ApplyOwner { // @Val yields the stored object, not a copy — mutate in place
  public void apply(@Val OwnerRequest request, @Val Owner owner) {
    owner.setFirstName(request.firstName());
    owner.setLastName(request.lastName());
  }
}
public class SaveOwner {
  public void save(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository repository) {
    repository.save(owner);
  }
}
public class RespondWithOwner {
  public void respond(@Val Owner owner, ObjectResponse<OwnerResponse> response) {
    response.send(OwnerResponse.from(owner)); // this step responds; 200 by default
  }
}
```

`src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/com.example.owner.OwnerNotFoundException.yml`

```yaml
handle:
  class: com.example.owner.HandleOwnerNotFound
```

```java
public class HandleOwnerNotFound {
  public void handle(@Parameter OwnerNotFoundException ex,
      ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<String>> response) {
    response.send(new ResponseEntity<>(ex.getMessage(), HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
  }
}
```

### Step wiring

Each top-level YAML entry is a developer-chosen step name; the first is the entry
point. `class:` names the function. **Give each function class exactly one public
method** — several public methods fail at start-up unless every reference adds
`method:`.

- `next: <step>` — run that step afterwards. This step's return value arrives there
  as `@Parameter T`.
- `outputs: { <name>: <step> }` — conditional branches. Declare a
  `@FunctionalInterface` parameter annotated `@Flow("<name>")` and call it to take the
  branch; not calling it short-circuits.

### Function parameters

Declare only what the step needs; they resolve by role:

- `@PathVariable`, `@RequestParam`, `@RequestBody` — Spring MVC annotations work.
- Spring beans (repositories, mappers, services) — injected by type as normal.
- `ObjectResponse<T>` (`net.officefloor.web.ObjectResponse`) — send the response with
  `response.send(dto)`. This is how a step responds; wrap as
  `ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<T>>` to set status explicitly.
- `@Parameter T` (`net.officefloor.plugin.section.clazz.Parameter`) — the previous
  step's return value, a `@Flow` argument, or a thrown escalation.

### Passing state between steps — `Out<T>` / `@Val`

Steps do not call each other. Beyond the single `@Parameter` hand-off, publish state
into a variable (`net.officefloor.plugin.variable`):

- Producer declares `Out<T>` and calls `set(...)`; consumer declares `@Val T`.
- Matching is **by type** — two variables of the same type in one pipeline need a
  `@Qualifier` annotation to disambiguate.
- `@Val` yields the same object the producer stored, **not a copy** — so an `Apply`
  step mutates the entity in place and later steps see the change.

### Naming

Verb plus entity: `Load<E>` (fetch by path variable, publishes `Out<E>`, throws when
absent) · `Build<E>` (construct from body) · `Validate<E>` (bind and validate the body,
publish it) · `Apply<E>` (mutate) · `Save<E>` · `Delete<E>` · `RespondWith<E>` (200) ·
`RespondWith<E>Created` (201) · `RespondWithNoContent` (204).

Keep DTOs at the edges — request body in at the first step, response DTO out at the
responder. Steps in between work with entities.

### Request body and validation

- The HTTP body can be read only once: **only one step per pipeline may bind
  `@RequestBody`**. A second binding fails at runtime. When later steps need it, the
  first step publishes it as a variable.
- `@Valid` runs before that step's method body, so step order decides when validation
  happens. Put the validating step first — otherwise a missing id returns 404 before an
  invalid body can return 400.

### Transactions

`govern: [ transaction ]` for writes, `govern: [ readonly-transaction ]` for reads,
listed on **every** step it covers. Both are provided by the starter. Governance spans
the pipeline, so the request commits once at the end.

### Errors

Functions throw; handlers respond. The exception must be **checked** (`extends
Exception`) so it appears in the `throws` clause. Put the handler in
`officefloor/escalation/<fully.qualified.ExceptionClass>.yml`, taking the exception as
`@Parameter` and responding via `ObjectResponse`. Matching is most-specific-first;
anything unmatched falls through to Spring `@RestControllerAdvice`.

### Security

Guard a whole endpoint file with a Spring Security SpEL expression:

```yaml
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"
```

# A refused statement (no signed-in user, unknown person) writes nothing, not even an audit line.

  class: net.officefloor.hq.app.statement.ValidateStatement
  next: load

  class: net.officefloor.hq.app.person.LoadPerson
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: before

  next: save

/** Cancel the person's last statement: only a steward may, and only of a person with a statement. The claims it
 *  bound become live again (a figure an earlier statement bound them to is not restored), there is one statement
 *  fewer, and the row shows the one before it (or none). Publishes the cancelled statement (its due-total; the
 *  claims it bound). */
public class CancelStatement {
    public void cancel(@Val StatementRequest request, @Val Person loaded, PersonRepository people,
            ClaimRepository claims, RoleRepository roles, Out<Statement> statement, Out<PersonResponse> saved)
            throws InvalidPersonException {
        if (!Role.STEWARD.equals(roles.of(loaded.sheetId(), request.user()))) {
            throw new InvalidPersonException("Only a steward may cancel a statement.");
        }
        people.lock(loaded);
        Person person = people.find(loaded.sheetId(), loaded.id());
        if (person.statementCount() == 0) {
            throw new InvalidPersonException(person.name() + " has no statement to cancel.");
        }
        int bound = 0;
        for (Claim c : claims.listForPerson(person.sheetId(), person.id())) {
            if (c.stated()) {
                bound++;
                claims.state(c, false, null);
            }
        }
        people.unstated(person);
        statement.set(new Statement(person.sheetId(), person.name(), person.statedTotal(), bound));
        saved.set(PersonResponse.from(people.find(person.sheetId(), person.id())));
    }
}

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.Claim;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.ClaimStatus;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.person.Grades;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.person.Holds;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.rate.RateRepository;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.setting.DatedAmount;

/** Claim figures and due-totals, as the screen shows them. */
public final class Dues {
    private Dues() {
    }

    /** A claim's figure: the due fixed when it was settled, else the one its last statement bound it to, n/a
     *  included (not while it is PENDING: then it is live), else live: its amount times its person's rate in force on
     *  its date for their grade then, divided by 100, rounded to two decimals as the claim rounds (see Rounding); null
     *  (n/a) when no rate applies. The floor is not in it: it is applied last (see shown). */
    public static BigDecimal figure(Claim claim, Grades grades, RateRepository rates, Rounding rounding) {
        if (claim.settledDue() != null) {
            return claim.settledDue();
        }
        if (claim.stated() && claim.status() != ClaimStatus.PENDING) {
            return claim.statedDue();
        }
        return live(claim, grades, rates, rounding);
    }

    /** A claim's due as its row shows it: the due fixed when it was settled, else the greater of the floor in force
     *  on its date and its figure (bound or live) with the late charge on it added (a correction, a negative amount,
     *  has no floor and no charge); null (n/a) when it has no figure. */
    public static BigDecimal shown(Claim claim, Grades grades, RateRepository rates, DatedAmount floor,
            LateCharge late) {
        if (claim.settledDue() != null) {
            return claim.settledDue();
        }
        BigDecimal figure = figure(claim, grades, rates, late.rounding());
        if (figure == null || claim.amount().signum() < 0) {
            return figure;
        }
        return figure.add(late.on(claim, figure)).max(floor.on(claim.date()));
    }

    /** A claim's live figure: its amount times its person's rate in force on its date for their grade then, divided
     *  by 100, rounded to two decimals as the claim rounds (see Rounding); null (n/a) when no rate applies. */
    public static BigDecimal live(Claim claim, Grades grades, RateRepository rates, Rounding rounding) {
        return rates.on(claim.sheetId(), grades.on(claim.date()), claim.date())
                .map(r -> claim.amount().multiply(r.pct()).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), 2, rounding.of(claim)))
                .orElse(null);
    }

    /** Whether a claim counts toward its person's figures and every live total: an OPEN, PENDING or SETTLED one,
     *  except an OPEN one dated within one of its person's holds and not bound by a statement, an OPEN or PENDING one
     *  not bound by a statement once its person's retirement date is reached (see retiredOut), and one deferred on the
     *  sheet's today (see Claim.deferredOn). */
    public static boolean counts(Claim claim, Holds holds, LocalDate retiredFrom, LocalDate today) {
        return claim.status().counts() && !claim.deferredOn(today)
                && !(claim.status() == ClaimStatus.OPEN && !claim.stated() && holds.covers(claim.date()))
                && !retiredOut(claim, retiredFrom, today);
    }

    /** Whether a claim leaves the live totals because its person is retired: the sheet's today is on or after their
     *  retirement date (null: not retired) and it is OPEN or PENDING and not bound by a statement. */
    private static boolean retiredOut(Claim claim, LocalDate retiredFrom, LocalDate today) {
        return retiredFrom != null && today != null && !today.isBefore(retiredFrom) && !claim.stated()
                && (claim.status() == ClaimStatus.OPEN || claim.status() == ClaimStatus.PENDING);
    }

    /** Whether a claim counts toward a period's due-totals: its status at the end of the period's last day (see
     *  ClaimLogRepository.statusesAt; null: it was added after) is OPEN, PENDING or SETTLED, and it is left out
     *  as the live rules leave it out: deferred on the sheet's today, or an OPEN one dated within one of its
     *  person's holds and not bound by a statement, or an OPEN or PENDING one of a retired person (see counts). */
    public static boolean countsAtEnd(Claim claim, ClaimStatus atEnd, Holds holds, LocalDate retiredFrom,
            LocalDate today) {
        return atEnd != null && atEnd.counts() && !claim.deferredOn(today)
                && !(claim.status() == ClaimStatus.OPEN && !claim.stated() && holds.covers(claim.date()))
                && !retiredOut(claim, retiredFrom, today);
    }

    /** A person's due-total: the dues (as shown) of their claims that count added up, skipping n/a; null (n/a) when
     *  their grade today has no rate today, unless a claim that counts has a figure (settled, stated, or live at
     *  the grade in force on its date). */
    public static BigDecimal total(String sheetId, List<Claim> claims, Grades grades, Holds holds,
            LocalDate retiredFrom, LocalDate today, RateRepository rates, DatedAmount floor, LateCharge late) {
        List<Claim> counted = claims.stream().filter(c -> counts(c, holds, retiredFrom, today)).toList();
        List<BigDecimal> figures = counted.stream().map(c -> shown(c, grades, rates, floor, late))
                .filter(f -> f != null).toList();
        if (figures.isEmpty() && rates.on(sheetId, grades.on(today), today).isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        return figures.stream().reduce(new BigDecimal("0.00"), BigDecimal::add);
    }

    /** A due-total at most the sheet's cap (null: none); n/a (null) is not capped. */
    public static BigDecimal capped(BigDecimal total, BigDecimal cap) {
        return total != null && cap != null ? total.min(cap) : total;
    }
}

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.Claim;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.ClaimRepository;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.setting.DatedAmount;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.setting.SettingRepository;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.sheet.SheetRepository;

/** The sheet's late charge as it is today: its late percent by date (a claim gains the one in force on each 30-day boundary past its due-by; a claim is overdue past its own due-by, fixed when
 *  it was created) and its today (null: none, so nothing is overdue). */
public record LateCharge(DatedAmount pct, LocalDate today, Rounding rounding) {

    /** The sheet's late charge as it is now. */
    public static LateCharge of(String sheetId, SettingRepository settings, SheetRepository sheets,
            ClaimRepository claims) {
        return new LateCharge(settings.latePct(sheetId), sheets.today(sheetId),
                Rounding.of(sheetId, settings, sheets, claims));
    }

    /** No late charge at all. */
    public static LateCharge none() {
        return new LateCharge(DatedAmount.always(BigDecimal.ZERO), null, Rounding.none());
    }

    /** Whether a claim is overdue: it is OPEN or PENDING, not deferred on today, and its due-by is before today. */
    public boolean overdue(Claim claim) {
        return claim.status().unsettled() && today != null && !claim.deferredOn(today)
                && claim.dueBy().isBefore(today);
    }

    /** The charge on a claim whose figure is `figure`: for each full 30 days it is overdue, the late percent in force
     *  on that boundary date (its due-by plus 30, 60, 90 ... days) of the figure, rounded to two decimals as the claim
     *  rounds (see Rounding), the charges added up (a boundary whose percent is 0.00 adds nothing); 0.00 when it is not
     *  overdue, or it is a correction (a negative amount). */
    public BigDecimal on(Claim claim, BigDecimal figure) {
        BigDecimal total = new BigDecimal("0.00");
        if (!overdue(claim) || claim.amount().signum() < 0) {
            return total;
        }
        long periods = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(claim.dueBy(), today) / 30;
        for (long n = 1; n <= periods; n++) {
            BigDecimal pct = this.pct.on(claim.dueBy().plusDays(30 * n));
            if (pct.signum() != 0) {
                total = total.add(figure.multiply(pct).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), 2, rounding.of(claim)));
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
}

import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.HashMap;

import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.Claim;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.ClaimRepository;

/** How the sheet rounds a claim's live figures: by its policy date (the policy-date setting, else the sheet's today;
 *  null: none, everything rounds half to even), and the dates of its numbered claims (a correction rounds by the
 *  date of the claim it corrects). */
public record Rounding(LocalDate policy, Map<String, LocalDate> numbered) {

    /** The sheet's rounding as it is now. */
    public static Rounding of(String sheetId, SettingRepository settings, SheetRepository sheets,
            ClaimRepository claims) {
        LocalDate policy = settings.policyDate(sheetId);
        Map<String, LocalDate> numbered = new HashMap<>();
        for (Claim c : claims.list(sheetId)) {
            if (c.number() != null) {
                numbered.put(c.number(), c.date());
            }
        }
        return new Rounding(policy != null ? policy : sheets.today(sheetId), numbered);
    }

    /** Every figure rounded half to even. */
    public static Rounding none() {
        return new Rounding(null, Map.of());
    }

    /** How a claim's live figures round: half up when it (a correction: the claim it corrects) is dated before the
     *  policy date, else half to even. */
    public RoundingMode of(Claim claim) {
        LocalDate date = claim.corrects() != null ? numbered.getOrDefault(claim.corrects(), claim.date())
                : claim.date();
        return policy != null && date.isBefore(policy) ? RoundingMode.HALF_UP : RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN;
    }
}

/** Take the person's statement: record their due-total now (late charges included, at most the sheet's cap) and the sheet's today, bind
 *  each of their claims that counts to its rate figure now (never the floor or its late charge, which keep following
 *  the sheet's floor and today), and unbind the rest (their due is live again; a claim deferred on today is left unbound). A settled claim's
 *  fixed due is left as it is. */
public class SaveStatement {
    public void save(@Val Person loaded, PersonRepository people, ClaimRepository claims, RateRepository rates,
            SheetRepository sheets, SettingRepository settings, Out<Statement> statement, Out<PersonResponse> saved) {
        people.lock(loaded);
        Person person = people.find(loaded.sheetId(), loaded.id());
        var today = sheets.today(person.sheetId());
        var floor = settings.floor(person.sheetId());
        List<Claim> theirs = claims.listForPerson(person.sheetId(), person.id());
        LateCharge late = LateCharge.of(person.sheetId(), settings, sheets, claims);
        BigDecimal total = Dues.capped(Dues.total(person.sheetId(), theirs, person.grades(), person.holds(),
                person.retiredFrom(), today, rates, floor, late), settings.cap(person.sheetId()));
        int counted = 0;
        for (Claim c : theirs) {
            if (Dues.counts(c, person.holds(), person.retiredFrom(), today)) {
                counted++;
                claims.state(c, true, Dues.figure(c, person.grades(), rates, late.rounding()));
            } else if (c.stated()) {
                claims.state(c, false, null);
            }
        }
        people.stated(person, total, today);
        statement.set(new Statement(person.sheetId(), person.name(), total, counted));
        saved.set(PersonResponse.from(people.find(person.sheetId(), person.id())));
    }
}

/** Cancel the person's last statement: only a steward may, and only of a person with a statement. The claims it
 *  bound become live again (a figure an earlier statement bound them to is not restored), there is one statement
 *  fewer, and the row shows the one before it (or none). Publishes the cancelled statement (its due-total; the
 *  claims it bound). */
public class CancelStatement {
    public void cancel(@Val StatementRequest request, @Val Person loaded, PersonRepository people,
            ClaimRepository claims, RoleRepository roles, Out<Statement> statement, Out<PersonResponse> saved)
            throws InvalidPersonException {
        if (!Role.STEWARD.equals(roles.of(loaded.sheetId(), request.user()))) {
            throw new InvalidPersonException("Only a steward may cancel a statement.");
        }
        people.lock(loaded);
        Person person = people.find(loaded.sheetId(), loaded.id());
        if (person.statementCount() == 0) {
            throw new InvalidPersonException(person.name() + " has no statement to cancel.");
        }
        int bound = 0;
        for (Claim c : claims.listForPerson(person.sheetId(), person.id())) {
            if (c.stated()) {
                bound++;
                claims.state(c, false, null);
            }
        }
        people.unstated(person);
        statement.set(new Statement(person.sheetId(), person.name(), person.statedTotal(), bound));
        saved.set(PersonResponse.from(people.find(person.sheetId(), person.id())));
    }
}

/** Claim figures and due-totals, as the screen shows them. */
public final class Dues {
    private Dues() {
    }

    /** A claim's figure: the due fixed when it was settled, else the one its last statement bound it to, n/a
     *  included (not while it is PENDING: then it is live), else live: its amount times its person's rate in force on
     *  its date for their grade then, divided by 100, rounded to two decimals as the claim rounds (see Rounding); null
     *  (n/a) when no rate applies. The floor is not in it: it is applied last (see shown). */
    public static BigDecimal figure(Claim claim, Grades grades, RateRepository rates, Rounding rounding) {
        if (claim.settledDue() != null) {
            return claim.settledDue();
        }
        if (claim.stated() && claim.status() != ClaimStatus.PENDING) {
            return claim.statedDue();
        }
        return live(claim, grades, rates, rounding);
    }

    /** A claim's due as its row shows it: the due fixed when it was settled, else the greater of the floor in force
     *  on its date and its figure (bound or live) with the late charge on it added (a correction, a negative amount,
     *  has no floor and no charge); null (n/a) when it has no figure. */
    public static BigDecimal shown(Claim claim, Grades grades, RateRepository rates, DatedAmount floor,
            LateCharge late) {
        if (claim.settledDue() != null) {
            return claim.settledDue();
        }
        BigDecimal figure = figure(claim, grades, rates, late.rounding());
        if (figure == null || claim.amount().signum() < 0) {
            return figure;
        }
        return figure.add(late.on(claim, figure)).max(floor.on(claim.date()));
    }

    /** A claim's live figure: its amount times its person's rate in force on its date for their grade then, divided
     *  by 100, rounded to two decimals as the claim rounds (see Rounding); null (n/a) when no rate applies. */
    public static BigDecimal live(Claim claim, Grades grades, RateRepository rates, Rounding rounding) {
        return rates.on(claim.sheetId(), grades.on(claim.date()), claim.date())
                .map(r -> claim.amount().multiply(r.pct()).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), 2, rounding.of(claim)))
                .orElse(null);
    }

    /** Whether a claim counts toward its person's figures and every live total: an OPEN, PENDING or SETTLED one,
     *  except an OPEN one dated within one of its person's holds and not bound by a statement, an OPEN or PENDING one
     *  not bound by a statement once its person's retirement date is reached (see retiredOut), and one deferred on the
     *  sheet's today (see Claim.deferredOn). */
    public static boolean counts(Claim claim, Holds holds, LocalDate retiredFrom, LocalDate today) {
        return claim.status().counts() && !claim.deferredOn(today)
                && !(claim.status() == ClaimStatus.OPEN && !claim.stated() && holds.covers(claim.date()))
                && !retiredOut(claim, retiredFrom, today);
    }

    /** Whether a claim leaves the live totals because its person is retired: the sheet's today is on or after their
     *  retirement date (null: not retired) and it is OPEN or PENDING and not bound by a statement. */
    private static boolean retiredOut(Claim claim, LocalDate retiredFrom, LocalDate today) {
        return retiredFrom != null && today != null && !today.isBefore(retiredFrom) && !claim.stated()
                && (claim.status() == ClaimStatus.OPEN || claim.status() == ClaimStatus.PENDING);
    }

    /** Whether a claim counts toward a period's due-totals: its status at the end of the period's last day (see
     *  ClaimLogRepository.statusesAt; null: it was added after) is OPEN, PENDING or SETTLED, and it is left out
     *  as the live rules leave it out: deferred on the sheet's today, or an OPEN one dated within one of its
     *  person's holds and not bound by a statement, or an OPEN or PENDING one of a retired person (see counts). */
    public static boolean countsAtEnd(Claim claim, ClaimStatus atEnd, Holds holds, LocalDate retiredFrom,
            LocalDate today) {
        return atEnd != null && atEnd.counts() && !claim.deferredOn(today)
                && !(claim.status() == ClaimStatus.OPEN && !claim.stated() && holds.covers(claim.date()))
                && !retiredOut(claim, retiredFrom, today);
    }

    /** A person's due-total: the dues (as shown) of their claims that count added up, skipping n/a; null (n/a) when
     *  their grade today has no rate today, unless a claim that counts has a figure (settled, stated, or live at
     *  the grade in force on its date). */
    public static BigDecimal total(String sheetId, List<Claim> claims, Grades grades, Holds holds,
            LocalDate retiredFrom, LocalDate today, RateRepository rates, DatedAmount floor, LateCharge late) {
        List<Claim> counted = claims.stream().filter(c -> counts(c, holds, retiredFrom, today)).toList();
        List<BigDecimal> figures = counted.stream().map(c -> shown(c, grades, rates, floor, late))
                .filter(f -> f != null).toList();
        if (figures.isEmpty() && rates.on(sheetId, grades.on(today), today).isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        return figures.stream().reduce(new BigDecimal("0.00"), BigDecimal::add);
    }

    /** A due-total at most the sheet's cap (null: none); n/a (null) is not capped. */
    public static BigDecimal capped(BigDecimal total, BigDecimal cap) {
        return total != null && cap != null ? total.min(cap) : total;
    }
}

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.Claim;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.claim.ClaimRepository;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.setting.DatedAmount;

/** The sheet's late charge as it is today: its late percent by date (a claim gains the one in force on each 30-day boundary past its due-by; a claim is overdue past its own due-by, fixed when
 *  it was created) and its today (null: none, so nothing is overdue). */
public record LateCharge(DatedAmount pct, LocalDate today, Rounding rounding) {

    /** The sheet's late charge as it is now. */
    public static LateCharge of(String sheetId, SettingRepository settings, SheetRepository sheets,
            ClaimRepository claims) {
        return new LateCharge(settings.latePct(sheetId), sheets.today(sheetId),
                Rounding.of(sheetId, settings, sheets, claims));
    }

    /** No late charge at all. */
    public static LateCharge none() {
        return new LateCharge(DatedAmount.always(BigDecimal.ZERO), null, Rounding.none());
    }

    /** Whether a claim is overdue: it is OPEN or PENDING, not deferred on today, and its due-by is before today. */
    public boolean overdue(Claim claim) {
        return claim.status().unsettled() && today != null && !claim.deferredOn(today)
                && claim.dueBy().isBefore(today);
    }

    /** The charge on a claim whose figure is `figure`: for each full 30 days it is overdue, the late percent in force
     *  on that boundary date (its due-by plus 30, 60, 90 ... days) of the figure, rounded to two decimals as the claim
     *  rounds (see Rounding), the charges added up (a boundary whose percent is 0.00 adds nothing); 0.00 when it is not
     *  overdue, or it is a correction (a negative amount). */
    public BigDecimal on(Claim claim, BigDecimal figure) {
        BigDecimal total = new BigDecimal("0.00");
        if (!overdue(claim) || claim.amount().signum() < 0) {
            return total;
        }
        long periods = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(claim.dueBy(), today) / 30;
        for (long n = 1; n <= periods; n++) {
            BigDecimal pct = this.pct.on(claim.dueBy().plusDays(30 * n));
            if (pct.signum() != 0) {
                total = total.add(figure.multiply(pct).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), 2, rounding.of(claim)));
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
}

/** How the sheet rounds a claim's live figures: by its policy date (the policy-date setting, else the sheet's today;
 *  null: none, everything rounds half to even), and the dates of its numbered claims (a correction rounds by the
 *  date of the claim it corrects). */
public record Rounding(LocalDate policy, Map<String, LocalDate> numbered) {

    /** The sheet's rounding as it is now. */
    public static Rounding of(String sheetId, SettingRepository settings, SheetRepository sheets,
            ClaimRepository claims) {
        LocalDate policy = settings.policyDate(sheetId);
        Map<String, LocalDate> numbered = new HashMap<>();
        for (Claim c : claims.list(sheetId)) {
            if (c.number() != null) {
                numbered.put(c.number(), c.date());
            }
        }
        return new Rounding(policy != null ? policy : sheets.today(sheetId), numbered);
    }

    /** Every figure rounded half to even. */
    public static Rounding none() {
        return new Rounding(null, Map.of());
    }

    /** How a claim's live figures round: half up when it (a correction: the claim it corrects) is dated before the
     *  policy date, else half to even. */
    public RoundingMode of(Claim claim) {
        LocalDate date = claim.corrects() != null ? numbered.getOrDefault(claim.corrects(), claim.date())
                : claim.date();
        return policy != null && date.isBefore(policy) ? RoundingMode.HALF_UP : RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN;
    }
}

/** Take the person's statement: record their due-total now (late charges included, at most the sheet's cap) and the sheet's today, bind
 *  each of their claims that counts to its rate figure now (never the floor or its late charge, which keep following
 *  the sheet's floor and today), and unbind the rest (their due is live again; a claim deferred on today is left unbound). A settled claim's
 *  fixed due is left as it is. */
public class SaveStatement {
    public void save(@Val Person loaded, PersonRepository people, ClaimRepository claims, RateRepository rates,
            SheetRepository sheets, SettingRepository settings, Out<Statement> statement, Out<PersonResponse> saved) {
        people.lock(loaded);
        Person person = people.find(loaded.sheetId(), loaded.id());
        var today = sheets.today(person.sheetId());
        var floor = settings.floor(person.sheetId());
        List<Claim> theirs = claims.listForPerson(person.sheetId(), person.id());
        LateCharge late = LateCharge.of(person.sheetId(), settings, sheets, claims);
        BigDecimal total = Dues.capped(Dues.total(person.sheetId(), theirs, person.grades(), person.holds(),
                person.retiredFrom(), today, rates, floor, late), settings.cap(person.sheetId()));
        int counted = 0;
        for (Claim c : theirs) {
            if (Dues.counts(c, person.holds(), person.retiredFrom(), today)) {
                counted++;
                claims.state(c, true, Dues.figure(c, person.grades(), rates, late.rounding()));
            } else if (c.stated()) {
                claims.state(c, false, null);
            }
        }
        people.stated(person, total, today);
        statement.set(new Statement(person.sheetId(), person.name(), total, counted));
        saved.set(PersonResponse.from(people.find(person.sheetId(), person.id())));
    }
}
